description: Opt-in overlay for repositories where a person reviews dependency updates but should not tick them one by one: minor, patch and pin updates share one pull request that opens without a dashboard tick and waits for a human merge. Digests are left to safe-automerge, majors keep the tick. Extend after the default preset.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and pin updates share one branch and open without a dashboard tick. One pull request per run instead of one per dependency: every open branch costs a CI run each time it is rebased.
The default preset drops the release-age soak because the dashboard tick was the gate. Without the tick the soak returns, so a freshly published release is not proposed the hour it appears.
Repeats the default preset's preset-bump rule after the grouping above, which would otherwise put the bump in the grouped branch and hold it a day.
